title: The BEST Gravel Frameset in 2024? Voicevelo G Major

takeaways.text: The frameset includes a carbon stem that routes hoses under the bar or fully internal, a compliance seatpost and a Kevlar-reinforced steerer; there are many bag and bottle mounts but none on the fork, and four sizes (S–XL, roughly 158–186 cm riders) with low stack.

Repeats VoiceVelo's frame weights (790 g lightest size M paint, 890 g heaviest size M; 855 g for this size S paint) and clearance of 700×47C or 650B×2.1 in; the frame was sent by a component brand and the presenter's store sells it.

On 38 mm tires it felt confident, stable at speed and very nimble on rough Chinese dirt roads; the seatpost smoothed small ruts but could kick on larger ones. The presenter called it his favourite gravel bike so far.
Niggles: the front caliper bolts pass through the fork from the front, so L-Twoo's caliper adapter needed different bolts, and the seat-tube bottle mount sits too high for a frame bag.
Quoted at US$2,099 for the frameset in January 2024; his 1× build weighed about 6.9 kg.

disclosure: China Cycling's founder also leads Panda Podium, and the video links to that retailer's G Major listing.
summary: Detailed model introduction, complete build, and ride discussion for the G Major; current availability, support, and mainland-China price remain unverified.
